cap_cx.estimator: cap wall cone fit (axes.json): Z-parallel axis, faces z 2.8-12.9, lever sector -50..50 excluded

cap_R_z0.estimator: cone r(z)=R0+k z extrapolated to the crown plane z=0 (same fit)

crown_round_R.estimator: circle fit in (r,z) to cap faces r 10.0-12.9, z 0.06-2.6, theta outside -60..60 (cap frame)

crown_z.estimator: area-weighted mean z of crown faces (n_z<-0.995, r<10) - the datum primary plane

step_z.estimator: area-weighted z of up(+Z)-facing faces: [cap annulus r 12.55-13.05, lever underside x>23]

step_edge_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) cap faces r 12.85-13.4, z 12.9-13.66, n_z>0.05 (edge round wall->step face)

mouth_chamfer_slope.estimator: line z=a+b r through the mouth chamfer faces r 11.95-12.45 (collar frame)

mouth_ring_z.estimator: area-weighted z of +Z-facing ring faces r 11.45-11.95

collar_top_round_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) faces r 11.1-11.55, z 14.1-14.5, n_z>0.1 (concave round ring face -> collar)

collar_bot_z.estimator: area-weighted z of +Z-facing faces r 10.25-10.8, z 16.3-16.9

collar_bot_round_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) faces r 10.6-11.2, z 15.9-collar_bot_z, n_z>0.1 (convex round collar -> bottom face)

groove_out_rc.estimator: median over 30-deg sectors of circle fits (r,z) to the collar-face groove faces r 8.9-10.25 (collar frame)

flange_z.estimator: mean of 45-deg sector medians of z of +Z-facing faces r 7.4-8.6 (stem flange ring face; the face is not level: see spread)

stem_axis_x0.estimator: line fit through 20 station centres (stem core, neck, sleeve, bore), axis_stations.json

stem_axis_y0.estimator: line fit through 20 station centres (stem core, neck, sleeve, bore), axis_stations.json

stem_axis_dxdz.estimator: line fit through 20 station centres (stem core, neck, sleeve, bore), axis_stations.json

stem_axis_dydz.estimator: line fit through 20 station centres (stem core, neck, sleeve, bore), axis_stations.json

stem_core_R_z18.estimator: line R(z) through stem-core station circle fits z 18.5-27.5, evaluated at z=18

neck_R.estimator: mean of neck station circle fits z 30.3, 30.9

shoulder_profile_between_ribs.estimator: median r of outward faces per 0.1 mm z, theta 20-70 mod 90 (between ribs), stem frame

stem_core_top_z.estimator: highest z (0.1 steps) where the between-rib radius is within 0.06 of the core line

neck_bot_z.estimator: lowest z (0.1 steps) where the between-rib radius is within 0.05 of neck_R

rib_theta_deg.estimator: per rib: (r-5.7)-weighted mean azimuth of rib faces r>5.75, z 18-27.5 (stem frame)

rib_tip_r_z18.estimator: per rib: p98 radius in +-12 deg, z 17.5-18.5

rib_tip_r_z27.estimator: per rib: p98 radius in +-12 deg, z 26.5-27.5

rib_width.estimator: per rib: tangential extent at r=5.85+-0.06, median over z 18.5-27 (1 mm steps)

rib_top_z.estimator: per rib: z where the crest radius (max r within +-2.5 deg, 0.05 mm steps) crosses the midpoint between the z=27 tip radius and the core radius at z=28

groove_in_rc.estimator: median of circle fits (r,z) to +Z-ish faces r 5.5-7.1, z 15.6-16.9, 50-deg sectors between ribs (stem frame)

sleeve_bottom_z.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_bottom_ramp_start_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_bottom_ramp_end_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_bottom_ramp_h.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve bottom edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_top_z.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_top_ramp_start_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_top_ramp_end_deg.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_top_ramp_h.estimator: piecewise fit (level + linear helical ramp + step) to the sleeve top edge heights at 3-deg azimuths (jog.json)

sleeve_crest_R.estimator: fit of touching-arc ripple r(z)=Rc-rho+sqrt(rho^2-dz^2), period p, to sleeve OD faces z 32.6-36.95, theta -95..120 (planar sector, stem frame)

sleeve_first_crest_z.estimator: same fit: z of the first crest

sleeve_ripple_depth_derived.estimator: rho - sqrt(rho^2 - (p/2)^2) from the ripple fit (derived, not a param)

sleeve_bot_round_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) sleeve faces z bottom_level..+0.6, r 5.0-6.05, n_z<-0.1, planar sector

sleeve_top_round_R.estimator: circle fit (r,z) sleeve faces z top_level-0.6..top_level, r 5.3-6.05, n_z>0.1, planar sector

sleeve_tail_r_in.estimator: p2 radius of scan faces above top_level+0.25 inside the top-ramp sector (inner edge of the helical tail)

bore_R.estimator: mean of bore station circle fits z 36.3, 36.8 (inward faces)

bore_shoulder_slope.estimator: line z=a+b r through +Z-facing bore-shoulder faces r 2.8-4.05, z 34.8-36.0

bore_seen_min_z.estimator: p0.5 z of scan faces inside the bore (deepest observed)

bore_seen_min_r.estimator: p1 radius of bore faces below z 35.3 (innermost observed)

lever_flank_py_y18_z0.estimator: lever +Y flank: line y(x=18)(z) through per-z plane-strip fits z 4-12.8 (lever.json), extrapolated to z=0

lever_flank_py_plan_deg.estimator: median over z of the per-z plan slope dy/dx (lever.json)

lever_flank_my_y18_z0.estimator: lever -Y flank: line y(x=18)(z) through per-z plane-strip fits z 4-12.8 (lever.json), extrapolated to z=0

lever_flank_my_plan_deg.estimator: median over z of the per-z plan slope dy/dx (lever.json)

lever_tip_R_z0.estimator: tip cone: line R(z) through per-z circle fits of tip faces x>23.5 (lever.json), extrapolated to z=0

lever_tip_cx.estimator: median of per-z tip circle centres x

lever_tip_cy.estimator: median of per-z tip circle centres y

lever_blend_R_z0.estimator: line R(z) through plan circle fits to the concave lever-cap blend faces (z 4, 7, 10, 12.5; both sides), extrapolated to z=0 (a drafted concave blend shrinks with z)

lever_crown_round_R.estimator: circle fit (x,z) to lever-tip crown-round faces x>23.8, |y|<2, z 0.06-2.9

lever_under_edge_R.estimator: circle fit (x,z) lever-tip underside edge faces x>26.6, |y|<2, z 12.8-13.8

pocket_y_plus_at_step.estimator: pocket wall 'wall+Y (normal -Y)': line through per-z medians z 10-13.3 (pocket.json), evaluated at the lever step face z

pocket_y_minus_at_step.estimator: pocket wall 'wall-Y (normal +Y)': line through per-z medians z 10-13.3 (pocket.json), evaluated at the lever step face z

pocket_x_inner_at_step.estimator: pocket wall 'end_inner (normal +X)': line through per-z medians z 10-13.3 (pocket.json), evaluated at the lever step face z

pocket_floor_z.estimator: floor seen sparsely: 64 +Z-facing faces in the pocket footprint, z p5 8.42 / p50 8.65 (pocket.json); value = mid of p5..p50

pocket_end_cx.estimator: plan circle fit to the pocket outer-end wall faces x 19.9-22.6, z 11.8-13.4 (inward-facing)

pocket_corner_R.estimator: mean of plan circle fits to the two inner-end corner wall faces (z 11.5-13.4)

stem_base_z.estimator: lowest z (0.1 steps, z 16.6-19.5) where the between-rib median outward radius is within 0.03 of the stem-core cone line (stem frame)
